problem: Commercial lot owners need to distinguish their own levy obligation from an owners-corporation borrowing decision before comparing cash, a strata loan and short-term property-secured finance.

targeting.primaryQuery: commercial strata special levy finance Australia
targeting.audience: Australian commercial strata lot owners, investors and business borrowers facing a special levy

uniqueValue: Separates individual lot-owner authority from owners-corporation governance and borrowing authority.
Compares cash, scheme-level strata borrowing and individual property-secured finance without treating them as interchangeable.

evidence.summary: Australian results are dominated by legal and strata-management explanations, leaving a commercial lot-owner finance comparison gap.
NSW Government guidance on levies, unit entitlements and owners-corporation decisions.
